units.source_text: 十月二十三日斋期圆满，举办贺宴。

en.t: On the twenty-third day of the tenth month, the period of purification came to an end, and a congratulatory banquet was held.

units.source_text: 六条院内人口密集，几无隙地，故紫夫人将寿筵设在她所认为私邸的二条院中。

en.t: Because the Rokujo estate was crowded with people and had almost no space to spare, Lady Murasaki arranged the longevity banquet at Nijo, which she regarded as her private residence.

units.source_text: 从服装以至一切主要事务，皆由紫夫人一人办理。

en.t: From the clothing to every major arrangement, Lady Murasaki handled everything herself.

units.source_text: 其他诸夫人也都自动前来帮助，分担适当的任务。

en.t: The other ladies also came of their own accord to help, each taking on a suitable share of the work.

units.source_text: 厢房等本来是侍女们的房间，这一天叫她们让出，作为殿上人、诸大夫、院司以至下级人员的飨宴之所，布置得很精雅。

en.t: The side rooms and similar spaces, normally used by the ladies-in-waiting, were vacated for the day and elegantly arranged as banquet rooms for courtiers, officials, estate officers, and even lower-ranking attendants.

units.source_text: 正殿的客堂照例装饰得富丽堂皇，中设嵌螺钿的椅子，作为寿翁座位。

en.t: The reception hall of the main building was decorated with the usual splendor, and in the center stood a chair inlaid with mother-of-pearl for the honored celebrant.

units.source_text: 主屋的西面一个房间里，设有十二个衣架，上面放着冬夏各种服装及被褥等物，照例用紫色绫绸覆盖，色彩非常艳丽，但看不见里面的物品。

en.t: In a room on the west side of the main house, twelve garment stands had been set up with winter and summer robes, bedding, and other items, all covered as usual with purple figured silk whose colors were brilliantly vivid, though the things beneath could not be seen.

units.source_text: 源氏面前设有两张桌子，上面盖着中国绫罗桌毯，其色彩自上而下由淡渐浓。

en.t: Two tables were placed before Genji, covered with Chinese silk table cloths whose colors deepened gradually from pale shades at the top to richer tones below.

units.source_text: 载插头花的台，以雕花沉香木为台足，插头花中有停在白银枝上的黄金鸟，乃明石女御所献，是她母亲明石夫人所设计的，意匠特别巧妙。

en.t: The stand holding the flowers for the hair had carved aloeswood legs, and among the ornaments was a golden bird perched on a silver branch, an offering from the Akashi Empress and a design by her mother, Lady Akashi, of especially ingenious workmanship.

units.source_text: 寿翁座位后面的四折屏风，是紫夫人的父亲式部卿亲王所赠，式样非常雅致。

en.t: The four-panel folding screen behind the celebrant's seat was a gift from Lady Murasaki's father, Prince Shikibukyo, and its style was exceptionally elegant.

units.source_text: 上面所绘的照例是四季景色，但泉水和瀑布等都很别致，异常新颖悦目。

en.t: As usual, the paintings on it showed scenes of the four seasons, but the springs, waterfalls, and other details were highly distinctive, strikingly fresh, and pleasing to the eye.

units.source_text: 北面靠壁放着两个柜子，里面盛着应有的种种装饰品。

en.t: Against the northern wall stood two cabinets, filled with all the various ornaments that were required.

units.source_text: 南厢是上级官员的座位，自左右大臣、式部卿亲王以至其次诸人，无不到席。

en.t: The southern side room was reserved for high-ranking officials, and everyone was present, from the Ministers of the Left and Right and Prince Shikibukyo down to the next ranks below them.

units.source_text: 舞台左右张着天幕，为乐人休息之所。

en.t: Canopies were stretched to the left and right of the stage to serve as resting places for the musicians.

units.source_text: 东西两边设有屯食八十客，又并列着盛犒赏品的中国式柜子四十个。

en.t: On the east and west sides, eighty servings of tonjiki provisions were set out, and forty Chinese-style cabinets for reward gifts were lined up beside them.
